lines: Loop value-flow bug fixed (3652414): the header now records its region's output as its carried value before the next iteration, and a resumed iteration is seeded with what its region produced before the suspension. Before the fix the exit condition judged the newer value while the region's entry node kept receiving the loop's original input, so a refine loop repeated the same work and only appeared to progress. Rust lib 438 passed; the new test fails without the fix.

Noted, undecided: an approval node inside a region reuses the single resume decision on later iterations (approve-once becomes approve-always); an unbounded loop whose condition never holds runs until Stop; and an agent's internal model-tool loop is uncapped (legacy_maximum_turns: None), so a model that never stops calling tools burns calls without any loop node.
